Hi Sylvia — great speaking earlier. Below is a concise breakdown so you can share with legal/procurement quickly. TL;DR: we can meet strict EU residency with Private VPC or a Dedicated EU-only cluster; Hosted API can be restricted to EU region but has limited fallback behavior — I outline tradeoffs below. Attaching SOC2 summary for procurement (SOC2_summary.pdf).

1) Hosted API (fastest onboarding)
- Region controls: requests can be routed to eu-west-1 (EU) only for Western EU customers; we can provide regional routing policy to restrict processing to EU infra.
- Cross-region fallbacks: by default we have automated fallbacks for availability (these can be disabled for residency-sensitive customers). If you require no cross-region fallback, we will enforce hard routing to EU and provide SLA for that config.
- Logs and metrics: application logs and model telemetry can be configured to stay in-region; we will provide contractual controls and audit access.
- When Hosted is used with strict no-fallback policy, some resilience features (multi-region failover) will be disabled — we should discuss your RTO/RPO tolerance.

2) Dedicated Capacity (reserved GPUs in our EU cluster) 
- Provides tenant-isolated GPU pools sitting in an EU region. No shared eviction with other tenants; regional HA options within EU are available.
- Typical lead time: 2–4 weeks from contract signature for standard configs, longer for custom sizing.
- Good interim option if you want faster time-to-prod than Private while keeping data in EU.

3) Private VPC / On-prem (highest control)
- Full control plane in your VPC (or on-prem container bundle). Best for regulated PHI/health customers.
- Typical timeline: 6–8 weeks for VPC onboarding + networking and KMS integration; on-prem full installs can be longer depending on ops.

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm which residency mode you want us to price (Hosted w/ no-fallback, Dedicated EU-only, or Private VPC).
- If Private or Dedicated, Marissa will follow up with sizing and lead times; Ben can review network/KMS requirements.
- I'll share SOC2_summary.pdf and a one-pager deployment checklist (see link).

Would you be available for a 30-min technical deep dive on Wed 08/04? If so, what times work for your ops/security?

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
